title: KooCADCAM Watch Front-Case Spec
description: Product spec consumed by WatchFrontModel (build steps 1-10 + runDFM). Source of truth: src/engine/WatchFrontModel.cpp; numeric ranges mirror src/gui/ParameterPanel.cpp spin-box ranges where a widget exists, otherwise conservative DFM/physical floors.

form_factor.description: Case silhouette; engine defaults to "round" when omitted.

base.description: Step 1 buildBase. diameter_mm is read for form_factor=round; width_mm/height_mm for square (conditionality not expressible with the mini-validator keyword set).

diameter_mm.description: Case outer diameter in mm (round form factor only).

width_mm.description: Case width (X) in mm (square form factor only).

height_mm.description: Case height (Y) in mm (square form factor only).

initial_corner_r_mm.description: Vertical-corner fillet radius in mm (square form only; engine default 2.0).

r_top_mm.description: Top rim (zMax) fillet radius in mm.

r_side_mm.description: Bottom rim (zMin) fillet radius in mm.

bezel.description: Step 3 buildBezel — annular ring cut at the top face.

width_mm.description: Bezel ring radial width in mm (DFM-009 hard floor 0.6).

depth_mm.description: Bezel ring cut depth in mm.

taper_deg.description: Bezel outer-wall taper angle in degrees (0 = straight walls; engine default 0).

display_pocket.description: Step 4 buildDisplayPocket (optional step — omit the object to skip).

depth_pocket_mm.description: Display pocket depth from the top face in mm.

glass_offset_mm.description: Glass seating offset in mm (negative = recessed below rim; engine default 0).

crown_cavity.description: Step 5 addCrownCavity (optional step — omit the object to skip).

side_angle_deg.description: Angular position on the side wall in degrees (0 = +X = 3 o'clock, CCW).

height_pos_mm.description: Cavity centre height above the case bottom in mm.

depth_mm.description: Crown counterbore radial depth in mm.

diameter_mm.description: Crown counterbore diameter in mm (DFM-002 floor 0.8).

shaft_dia_mm.description: Crown shaft through-hole diameter in mm (DFM-002 floor 0.8).

side_buttons.description: Step 6 addSideButtons — side pocket cut per entry (optional step; empty array = skip).

angle_deg.description: Angular position on the side wall in degrees (0 = +X = 3 o'clock, CCW).

height_mm.description: Pocket centre height above the case bottom in mm.

length_mm.description: Pocket length along the side-wall tangent in mm.

width_mm.description: Pocket width along the case axis in mm.

depth_mm.description: Pocket radial depth in mm (DFM-006 cap = min(0.8, thickness - 0.3)).

taper_deg.description: Pocket wall taper in degrees (not implemented in M1.5; engine treats values > 0 as 0 with warning).

speaker_grille.description: Step 7 addSpeakerGrille — rows x cols radial perforation array (optional step).

angle_deg.description: Grille centre angular position in degrees (0 = +X = 3 o'clock, CCW).

height_pos_mm.description: Grille centre height above the case bottom in mm.

rows.description: Number of hole rows along the case axis (count).

cols.description: Number of hole columns along the wall tangent (count).

row_spacing_mm.description: Row pitch in mm (DFM-014: pitch - hole_dia >= 0.25; floor = 0.8 + 0.25).

col_spacing_mm.description: Column pitch in mm (DFM-014: pitch - hole_dia >= 0.25; floor = 0.8 + 0.25).

hole_dia_mm.description: Perforation hole diameter in mm (DFM-002 floor 0.8).

rear_sensors.description: Step 8 addRearSensors — circular recesses drilled up from the rear face (optional step; empty array = skip).

offset_x_mm.description: Sensor centre X offset from the case centre in mm (bounded by max case radius).

offset_y_mm.description: Sensor centre Y offset from the case centre in mm (bounded by max case radius).

dia_mm.description: Sensor recess diameter in mm (DFM-002 floor 0.8).

depth_mm.description: Recess depth into the rear face in mm (must stay below base thickness).

lugs.description: Step 9 addLugs — strap-lug protrusions fused onto the case (optional step; empty array = skip).

angle_deg.description: Lug angular position in degrees (0 = +X = 3 o'clock, CCW; 90 = 12 o'clock).

length_mm.description: Lug radial protrusion length in mm.

width_mm.description: Lug width along the side-wall tangent in mm.

thickness_mm.description: Lug thickness along the case axis in mm.

pin_hole_dia_mm.description: Spring-bar pin through-hole diameter in mm (omit the key for no hole; DFM-002 floor 0.8, engine skips < 0.6 with warning).

pin_is_tapped.description: True if the pin hole is tapped — enables the DFM-015 surrounding-stock rule (default false = clearance hole).

secondary_fillets.description: Step 10 addSecondaryFillets — cosmetic fillets on the top rim and bezel inner step (optional step).

r_mm.description: Cosmetic fillet radius in mm (engine default 0.2; bezel step uses r * 0.5).
